tooltip.norsegear.field_whetstone: Repairs 20 durability on Norse equipment in opposite hand. Consumed on use.
tooltip.norsegear.war_horn: Strength I + Speed I for you and your team in 10 blocks (7 s). Cooldown: 45 s.
tooltip.norsegear.thrown_weapon: Right-click to throw. Recover the weapon after impact.
tooltip.norsegear.sling: Hold RMB to charge. Uses crafted stone shots; some can be recovered.
tooltip.norsegear.bossed_shield: Grants +2 armor while held in the offhand; also blocks attacks.
tooltip.norsegear.bog_iron: Find small deposits under Overworld soil. Buried in dirt, mud or clay around 2–4 blocks below terrain surface. Dig with a stone-or-better shovel, then refine using a pickaxe.
jei.norsegear.bog_iron_info: Bog iron generates across the Overworld, not only in swamps. Small pockets occur under terrain in dirt, mud and clay, normally about 2–4 blocks below the local surface. 50% of chunks get 2 generation attempts, but success depends on soil. Grass blocks are never replaced, and air-exposed deposits are discarded. Mine with stone-or-better shovels. Craft 1 bog iron plus 1 stone-or-better pickaxe into 1 iron ingot; the pickaxe is retained with 1 durability loss. Direct smelting is unavailable.
